1.finding: Basic EPS Rs 11.43 on PAT to owners Rs 145.68 cr = 12.75 crore weighted shares (the pre-conversion equity of 12.746 crore). CCDs (Rs 312.10 cr classed as equity) have since converted and a pre-IPO placement of Rs 84.29 cr at Rs 272.07 was made: pre-offer capital is 15.01 crore shares (p. 123). On that count FY26 EPS is Rs 9.70.

2.finding: CFO Rs 337.79 / 383.03 / 256.42 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 87.24 / 118.39 / 144.91 cr: cumulative CFO 2.2x PAT. Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 43.47 cr against PAT Rs 135.78 cr (seasonal kharif build of receivables).

3.finding: Current tax Rs 24.75 / 41.92 / 56.89 cr = 23-29% of PBT; income tax paid Rs 21.24 / 20.62 / 61.24 cr (p. 104).

4.finding: Related-party transactions not compiled in this run; the objects carry no related-party use (p. 182).

5.finding: Fresh issue is amount-based (Rs 355.00 cr), not a fixed share count; objects are Rs 270.00 cr of debt repayment (company Rs 247.94 cr, subsidiary Saffire Rs 22.06 cr) plus up to 35% for unidentified acquisitions and GCP.

7.finding: Other intangibles Rs 782.10 cr at Mar-26 (Rs 370.75 cr Mar-24) from acquired brands (Rs 483.46 cr asset purchase and Rs 242.98 cr I&B Seeds business in FY25, p. 104); amortised over 5-10 years: Rs 142.73 cr in FY26 (p. 508), about equal to PAT. Goodwill Rs 25.73 cr.

8.finding: 14,717 active distributors; over 98% of revenue from repeat customers; top 10 suppliers 38.18% of FY26 purchases (51.33% in Q1 FY27).

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 113.27 cr at Jun-26 (entry tax Rs 69.20 cr, GST Rs 33.35 cr), 5.8% of equity. Litigation against the company Rs 255.94 cr (11.77% of net worth), including 85 criminal cases (mostly Insecticides Act sampling matters typical of agrochemicals).

R1.finding: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP issued a MODIFIED opinion (FY24-26 and Q1 FY27): an insurance claim receivable of Rs 16.30 cr recognised in FY13, rejected by the insurer and under appeal in the Supreme Court, should not be recognised (a contingent asset). Equity would be Rs 16.30 cr lower; no P&L effect in FY24-26.

R3.finding: Fresh issue above Rs 100 cr: monitoring agency appointed.

R5.finding: Mainboard issue under Reg 6(1); QIB up to 50%, NII at least 15%, retail at least 35%.

R6.finding: IIFL, DAM Capital and Motilal Oswal: large, active managers; track record not compiled in this run.

rationale.g1: Revenue Rs 2,229.93 / 2,690.51 / 3,151.97 cr FY24-26 (+20.7%, +17.2%), helped by acquisitions (I&B Seeds from Nov-2024; brands bought in FY25) (pp. 101, 104, 306). Branded crop protection grew 46% FY24-26 against an industry 10-13% (p. 305). The projection assumes no further acquisitions: Neutral 13% fading to 9%; Bear 5-6% (below industry); Bull 17% fading to 11%.
rationale.m: Adjusted EBITDA (issuer KPI, excludes CCD fair-value change) 9.38% / 11.99% / 15.14% FY24-26 and 20.20% in seasonal Q1 FY27 (p. 186). Gross margin rose from 31.1% to 38.5% with branded mix. Neutral 14%; Bear 11.5% (FY25 level); Bull 16%.
rationale.nwc: Inventory + receivables - payables = 38% of FY26 revenue (Rs 1,199.07 cr); net working capital days 174 / 141 / 139 (p. 186). Neutral 37%; Bear 40%; Bull 34%.
rationale.capex: Cash D&A for the DCF is Rs 55.62 cr (PPE Rs 45.04 cr + right-of-use Rs 10.55 cr + investment property), i.e. reported D&A Rs 198.35 cr less Rs 142.73 cr amortisation of brands already paid for (p. 508); amortisation is non-cash and the projection assumes no further brand purchases. Organic capex = D&A + k x revenue growth, with FY26 PPE purchases Rs 77.54 cr (p. 104). Net debt Rs 507.41 cr = borrowings Rs 820.04 cr + leases Rs 77.64 cr - cash and bank Rs 106.39 cr - current investments Rs 199.58 cr (Mar-26, pp. 99-100) - pre-IPO placement Rs 84.29 cr used to repay debt (p. 160). Fresh issue Rs 355.00 cr; 4% expenses assumed.
